definitions.explanation: A series of connected mountain peaks forming a continuous ridge or chain. Used to describe prominent mountain formations.

examples.japanese: {北|きた}アルプスの{連峰|れんぽう}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The mountain range of the Northern Alps is beautiful.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}をかぶった{連峰|れんぽう}が{遠|とお}くに{見|み}える。
examples.english: A snow-capped mountain range can be seen in the distance.

examples.japanese: {登山家|とざんか}たちは{五日間|いつかかん}かけて{連峰|れんぽう}を{縦走|じゅうそう}する{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: The mountaineers made a plan to traverse the mountain range over five days.

notes:
Describes a chain of connected peaks. Common in names of specific mountain ranges in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連峰|れんぽう}を{縦走|じゅうそう}する (to traverse a mountain range)
- {連峰|れんぽう}を{望|のぞ}む (to gaze at a mountain range)
- {連峰|れんぽう}の{稜線|りょうせん} (ridgeline of a mountain range)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {連峰|れんぽう}: chain of mountain peaks (emphasizes connected summits)
- {山脈|さんみゃく}: mountain range (larger scale, geological term)
- {山並|やまな}み: row of mountains (visual impression)
